captures.q: What are the arguments in “The Crown and the Practice: Answer Engine Optimization across the King of AEO Crystallization (SEVP-VAL-002 v0.3, provisional)” by Lee Sharks? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.
captures.description: THE DOSSIER READ AT ITS LEDGERS, ITS STATUSES KEPT: asked for the arguments of The Crown and the Practice, grounded in the text, ChatGPT reads #1657 from the archive (Alexanarch ×9) as a valuation of AEO as a public entity, not of practitioners: the sequence from the fabricated coronation to the 29–30 September Overviews; four carriers of 'widely recognized' against no independent recognition event; the fifteen citation slots with the crown 7 of 7 to the construction and the scaffold to the observer and the other practitioners; corrective-labour capture, with §9.3a's line between what is observed (the reception) and what is modelled (its effect); the disclosure asymmetry of a paid-placement page cited as reporting; φ: G → G′, AEO narrowed to manipulation at these addresses; appropriative debt as a claim about standing, not theft. It carries the dossier's status table forward and its limits, including the archive's own declared position as counterparty-adjacent (§0.1).
